edits.original: Field crews still collect vouchers, make no mistake.
edits.reason: "make no mistake" is a finality interjection that adds no evidence to the claim.

edits.original: so the change significantly streamlines cell-wall composition analysis
edits.replacement: so the change cuts cell-wall composition analysis time from 40 minutes to 6 minutes
edits.reason: "significantly" is replaced with the numbers it stood in for.

edits.original: Rubisco is the only carboxylase in the Calvin-Benson cycle, full stop.
edits.replacement: Rubisco is the only carboxylase in the Calvin-Benson cycle.
edits.reason: "full stop" repeats the exclusivity already carried by "only" without adding evidence.
"dramatically" is an unsupported intensifier standing in for evidence not supplied in the text.

edits.original: so supplemental irrigation dramatically reduces yield loss in dry years
edits.replacement: so supplemental irrigation cut yield loss in dry years from 41 percent to 8 percent
edits.reason: "dramatically" is replaced with the numbers it stood in for.
"profoundly" is an intensifier with no supporting evidence.
